title: Associate - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Associate Business Analyst \- Associate \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 12 \- Associate**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Requirement Gathering/Documentation**
**Good to have skills: Basic understanding of APIs**
**Experience: 1 year – 2 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 As a Business Analyst \- you will support business analysis and requirement management activities by working closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts and project leadership. You will contribute to translating business needs into clearly documented requirements and support the delivery of digitally enabled solutions across client engagements. This role focuses on learning Accenture delivery methodologies, tools and ways of working while building foundational consulting and analysis skills.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Support the analysis of current\-state (as\-is) processes and assist in documenting future\-state (to\-be) processes under the direction of senior team members.
* Assist in planning, preparing and documenting client workshops, interviews and requirement gathering sessions.
* Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand stated requirements and contribute to documentation using process models, basic story maps, data analysis, and document reviews.
* Support day\-to\-day communication with delivery teams by helping clarify documented requirements and assumptions.
* Assist with iteration planning, backlog refinement and sprint activities, including drafting user stories and acceptance criteria under guidance.
* Support stakeholder engagement activities and help maintain alignment between the project team, client, and project leadership.
* Contribute to the identification of solution options by documenting business needs, dependencies and constraints to support decision\-making.
* Create and maintain requirement artefacts (user stories, process flows, functional documentation) based on Accenture and client\-defined standards.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to gather inputs required for analysis and documentation.
* Support alignment between requirements, solution design and implementation artefacts, escalating gaps or inconsistencies when identified.
* Assist in maintaining requirement traceability, accuracy and version control throughout the delivery lifecycle.

title: Application Development Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview Role Summary**
 Leads delivery execution across the three delivery teams while operating as a senior, hands\-on technical leader above Technical Lead level. The role requires strong engineering depth, active involvement in technical decision\-making, sprint delivery health, capacity and staffing management, engineering quality standards, and cross\-team dependency resolution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own sprint delivery health, capacity planning and staffing management across all three teams
* Set and enforce engineering quality standards across the delivery organization
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership across architecture decisions, design reviews, code\-quality practices, and complex engineering issue resolution
* Resolve cross\-team dependencies alongside the Agile Coach (RTE)
* Coordinate release readiness and launch\-position verification against the SOW's committed deliverables
* Act as the primary delivery\-management escalation point before issues are elevated to the Client Service Organization


**Required skills \& experience**
* 12\+ years engineering or delivery management experience across multi\-team software programs
* Strong grasp of sprint delivery health metrics, capacity planning and staffing management
* Experience setting and enforcing engineering quality standards across concurrent teams
* Must be technically stronger than a Technical Lead, with hands\-on experience in modern application development, system design, architecture oversight, code reviews, and production issue resolution
* Comfortable owning release\-readiness and launch\-position verification processes
* Proven ability to mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers while remaining hands\-on enough to challenge solution choices and guide implementation quality
* Experience escalating and resolving delivery risk in a client\-facing engagement


**Preferred qualifications**
* Experience managing staffing/backfill across a 25\+ person delivery organization
* Familiarity with AI/RAG delivery quality standards specifically


**Education**
 B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or a related field, MBA preferred, or equivalent practical experience; PMP or PgMP certification an advantage.
   

  

**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
   

  

****Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion****
 At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
   

  

 Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
   

  

 We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.
   

  

  

**\*\*\*Notice to Job Seekers Regarding Impersonation and Fraudulent Job Offers\*\*\***
 It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals,
 **specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
 All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
 **@milestone.tech.** 
 We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
   

  

**No Recruitment Fees**
 Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

title: Software Analyst 1
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

***Who We Are***
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.
   

  

***What We’re Looking For***
 The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.
   

  

***What’s in it for you?***
*The People* 
 \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.
   

  

*The Growth* 
 \- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

*The Technology* 
 \- You’ll get the chance to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

***What You’ll Do***
* Analyzing debug log files and crash analysis, bug identification, suggesting fixes and coordinating with the engineering team to implement the bug fixes in future releases for MobiControl products
* Identifying MobiControl server\-side and client\-side limitations based on information gathered from the customer’s production environment
* Working with internal teams to develop, maintain, and update diagnostic tools internally to check configuration\-related issues and log files for multiple mobile platforms
* Troubleshooting, researching, and coordinating with frontline teams to evaluate the issue and narrow down the process/procedure or method that is causing the failure
* Identifying issues that are caused by the latest operating system or product updates, and coordinating with the engineering team to provide patches for fixing the issues


***Experience You’ll Bring:***
* Degree in Computer Information/Application Systems, Enterprise Computing, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Experience: Good to have experience in MDM or software development or related field (Exceptions apply)
* Well\-versed with enterprise MDM solutions and applications
* Knowledge and experience with various mobile platforms such as Android, Android Enterprise, and iOS
* Knowledgeable in Java/Android/Kotlin, C\#, .NET, and development platforms such as Android Studio, and Visual Studio
* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures
* Excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with building custom applications for various use/business cases


 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.
